newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares open 17 pct down in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares open 17 pct down in Milan.

text.p: Shares in troubled Italian information technology group Olivetti opened 17.4 percent down at 619 lire per share on the Milan bourse, with trading starting late because pre-bourse quote kept exceeding fluctuation limits.
Olivetti shares, which were suspended on Thursday and Friday, last traded at 749.4 lire on Wednesday before their suspension by stock market watchdog Consob.
Earlier, the stock market council twice widened fluctuation bands first to 15 percent from the regular 10 percent limits and to 20 percent in efforts to allow Olivetti stock to start trading.
By 1012 GMT the share was priced 15.93 percent lower at 630.0.
